hints.title: Prime Number Identification
hints.text: Precompute primality for values using a standard sieve up to the maximum element.

hints.title: Consecutive Index Differences
hints.text: Track the gap distances between consecutively occurring prime positions in the subarray.

hints.title: Gap Spread Verification
hints.text: Verify whether the difference between the largest gap and smallest gap does not exceed k.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sieve precomputation followed by range gap tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-checking primality for every element inside nested loops is computationally redundant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boolean primality table trades O(M) space for O(1) checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintain running min and max gaps incrementally as the right pointer extends.
